mapper.insert: insert into xl_trip_countdown (user_id, title, destination_id, trip_date, remind_days, memo, create_time, update_time) values (#{userId}, #{title}, #{destinationId}, #{tripDate}, #{remindDays}, #{memo}, now(), now())
mapper.update: update xl_trip_countdown set title=#{title}, destination_id=#{destinationId}, trip_date=#{tripDate}, remind_days=#{remindDays}, memo=#{memo}, update_time=now() where id=#{id} and user_id=#{userId}
mapper.delete: delete from xl_trip_countdown where id=#{id} and user_id=#{userId}
mapper.select: select id, user_id, title, destination_id, trip_date, remind_days, memo, create_time, update_time from xl_trip_countdown where id=#{id}
select id, user_id, title, destination_id, trip_date, remind_days, memo, create_time, update_time from xl_trip_countdown where user_id=#{userId} order by trip_date asc
